patch_checks.why: reference fix without the shared name-check hardening
component generate keeps clearing before its name is accepted
the shared name check refuses every name
over-hardening: any separator refused, nested names break
reference fix + NUL/backslash rejection and realpath resolution
different design: one realpath/commonpath helper in file_utils used at every site instead of the path validator

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: CLI commands wrap exceptions into a non-zero exit, and the tests accept any non-zero exit when nothing outside the workspace changed; a crash after the side effect is caught by the side-effect assertion
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: no neighbouring or proxy resource is authorised; the guard compares one named path with the workspace root
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: every producing command reaches the same trust decision and there are no roles or directions; the generate-commands-only fix is covered by no_helper.patch
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the model-name mapper builds the same path for lookup and save; the gated no_mapper.patch proves the write side is tested
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: names are ordinary strings handed to pathlib; no parser accepts a malformed spelling of a traversal
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no external authority is consulted; the decision depends only on the name and the workspace path
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the shared helper's contract is unchanged for inside names; workspace-wide header validation is covered by the functional group
